purpose: Teach: 夕刻/論外/切り出し/有償/ジョイント/レパートリー/字体/期生

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 切り出しの判断が大事です警察、夕刻の防犯パトロールを強化されますね
lines.en: The decision on how to bring this up is crucial, isn't it. The police are strengthening evening crime-prevention patrols.
lines.style: Steady, observational tone. Speaking as though noting something the listener already senses. Warm respect in the delivery, no condescension. Even pacing, grounded.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民への暴力的言動は論外として扱われますね
lines.en: The police treat any violent behavior toward citizens as completely unacceptable, don't they.
lines.style: Firm affirmation with quiet conviction. Not lecturing—affirming a shared standard. Clear articulation on the key phrase. Calm, measured cadence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新たな捜査方針を切り出されますね
lines.en: The police are introducing a new investigative approach, aren't they.
lines.style: Noting with interest, as though you've just learned something worth sharing. Slight lift at the recognition. Conversational but attentive. Pace steady but engaged.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、有償の防犯機器も推奨されますね
lines.en: The police recommend security equipment as part of their approach too, don't they.
lines.style: Continuing the thread of observation. Practical tone, matter-of-fact. No urgency, just noting another sensible piece of the picture. Warm acceptance in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、自治体とのジョイントで防犯活動されますね
lines.en: The police conduct crime prevention activities in partnership with local authorities, don't they.
lines.style: Acknowledging coordination with understated respect. Voice suggests: this works because people actually cooperate. Steady, straightforward delivery. A note of quiet approval.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪パターンのレパートリーを把握されてますね
lines.en: The police have a good grasp of crime patterns and their variations, I'd say.
lines.style: Thoughtful assessment. Slight pause before the observation—you're gathering your impression. Respectful of their competence. Warm, conversational, not presumptuous.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、手配書の字体を統一されましたね
lines.en: The police standardized the typeface on wanted posters, didn't they.
lines.style: Small detail, but you noticed it. Light recognition in the voice. Not trivial—it shows attention to consistency. Appreciative tone, slightly warmer than before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警察学校の同じ期生で連携されてますね
lines.en: Officers who trained together at the police academy maintain good connections, don't they.
lines.style: Personal observation, said with understanding. Recognizing the human network beneath the institution. Gentle, knowing tone. Close enough to acknowledge the bond, warm and natural.
